stem: Which of the following was the main reason for the rapid settlement of the Great Plains during the late 1800s?

options.label: F
options.text: Congress passed a law requiring all public lands to be sold at auction.

options.label: G
options.text: Congress passed a law allowing people to claim public land and convert it to private property through homesteading.

options.label: H
options.text: Speculators bought large parcels of land and then built factory towns to attract new immigrants.

options.label: J
options.text: Native Americans sold most of their tribal lands directly to railroad companies.
